notes:
- ✨ Keeps your entries safe: when two devices edit the same entry, Dayspring won’t erase your work
- Smooths out sync so edits aren’t lost or overwritten, even during fast races between devices
- Fixes tricky multi-device moments so syncing “just finishes” end to end
- Stops photos from disappearing when your network is spotty
- Makes offline writing more reliable by ensuring prayers and scripture references (and other entry details) survive syncing
- Prevents one failed write from getting stuck and blocking the rest of your outbox
- Uses the server as the deciding factor for update times, so everything stays consistent across devices
- Adjusts onboarding on phones so archive import isn’t offered where it doesn’t work properly
